name: Tamoxifen PCT

card.summary: Tamoxifen PCT is the use of the anti-estrogen tamoxifen after an anabolic steroid or TRT course, aimed at restarting natural testosterone so that muscle gained during training is kept.
card.note: Prescription drug used off-label; serious adverse effects are documented and it should be medically supervised.

quick.overview:
Post-cycle therapy (PCT) is the phase after a steroid course in which users try to get their own testosterone production going again. Tamoxifen, sold as Nolvadex and nicknamed nolva, is one of the most-discussed drugs for this, usually mentioned alongside clomiphene (Clomid).

The appearance logic is a chain: recover natural testosterone and keep estrogen effects in check, hold on to muscle and avoid gynecomastia, and so keep the physique built during the cycle. Tamoxifen blocks estrogen feedback in the brain's hormonal axis, which raises LH and FSH and stimulates testicular testosterone. Published trials of PCT regimens in steroid users are lacking.
quick.how: On forums, tamoxifen is described as a pill taken for several weeks after the last injection, sometimes with clomiphene, and members trade views on timing and recovery. Others say bloodwork and a doctor should guide the process, and a member describes an endocrinologist advising a repeat PCT. Specific amounts are not given here.
quick.risks: Tamoxifen is prescription-only in the US, UK, Canada and Australia. Documented adverse effects include blood clots, stroke, liver effects and uterine changes (in women), plus hot flashes, and some drugs interfere with its action. Users report mood and libido problems during recovery, and forum members note that a prolonged low-hormone period can be hard and may need medical care.

lead: Tamoxifen PCT refers to using tamoxifen (nolva) as the post-cycle therapy drug after anabolic steroid or testosterone replacement exposure. Practitioners aim to restore natural testosterone production, preserve training gains and limit estrogen-related effects such as gynecomastia [1][2].

Tamoxifen is a selective estrogen receptor modulator approved for breast cancer. It acts as an estrogen antagonist in breast tissue, and by blocking estrogen feedback on the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis it raises LH and FSH and increases testicular testosterone production [3]. Off-label, it is used to prevent and treat gynecomastia [3].

Its role in bodybuilding PCT comes from forum and gym culture rather than controlled trials. Wikipedia notes that animal studies raise concerns about sperm quality and prostate and gonadal health [3].

chain: Tamoxifen blocks estrogen feedback in the brain
LH and FSH rise, stimulating the testes
Natural testosterone recovers, helping retain muscle and avoid gynecomastia
angle.text: Users take it to protect the physique built during a cycle by restoring their own testosterone. The goal is retention of muscle and avoidance of breast tissue growth.

paras: PCT is discussed in cycle threads on T Nation, where members recount plans that name tamoxifen after a cycle and sometimes in combination with clomiphene [2][4]. Others report recovery problems such as erectile difficulty after a cycle, with replies suggesting extended or combined regimens [5].
Tamoxifen is a nonsteroidal triphenylethylene SERM. By blocking estrogen negative feedback, it raises LH and FSH and thereby testicular testosterone output [3].

Serious effects documented in medical use include endometrial changes in women, stroke, pulmonary embolism, deep vein thrombosis, eye problems and liver toxicity; common effects include hot flashes. SSRIs can reduce its effectiveness through CYP2D6 [3]. Forum members describe low estradiol crashes and mood or libido problems around PCT [6].

Dora Richardson synthesised tamoxifen at ICI in 1962 as part of contraceptive research; it was marketed for advanced breast cancer in 1973 and generics became available after the patent expired in 2002 [3].

No studies found of tamoxifen PCT after steroid use. Tamoxifen itself has been studied in breast cancer, infertility and other conditions; a registered trial tested it in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, which is unrelated to appearance [3][7].

lore.intro: Tamoxifen features in cycle-planning threads as the standard PCT drug [2][4].

claims.claim: Tamoxifen after a cycle restores natural testosterone
claims.believers: Users post plans naming tamoxifen for the weeks after a cycle, and one reports an endocrinologist saying recent evidence supports PCTs [2][8].
claims.experts: Medical sources describe the HPG feedback mechanism, but no trial has tested PCT regimens in steroid users [3].

claims.believers: Cycle threads keep tamoxifen on hand for gynecomastia concerns [2].
claims.experts: Tamoxifen is used off-label for gynecomastia, with small studies cited [3].
